title: Change the name of a liquor licence
summary: Apply online to Liquor & Gaming NSW to get approval to change the name of your licensed premises.
intro:
If you want to change the name of your licensed premises, you need to apply for approval from Liquor & Gaming NSW. You can do this online. The new name must relate to the business you conduct on your premises.

For up-to-date liquor licence guidelines, resources and tools visit Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing.

If you have questions or feedback about liquor licensing contact Liquor & Gaming NSW.
who_can_apply: The new name must relate to the business conducted on the premises.
what_you_need: Licensee's details, including ACN, ABN, and Y/Inc (if applicable)
A copy of your record of registration of the business name that matches the proposed licence name
Notify interest in a liquor licence business (if the entity that holds the registration certificate is not listed on your licence)

how_to_steps.text: Enter your name and the required liquor licence number.
Follow the prompts to change the name of a liquor licence.

more_info.text: When lodging online, ensure all the documents you attach are in PDF format.
Applications will generally be determined within 7 working days.

internal_links.text: Notify interest in a liquor licence business

faqs.q: Where can I find up-to-date liquor licence guidelines and resources?
faqs.a: Visit the Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing page.

faqs.q: Who should I contact if I have questions about liquor licensing?
What do I need to apply to change the name of a liquor licence?
faqs.a: You need the licensee's details (including ACN, ABN, Y/Inc if applicable), the reason for the name change, a copy of your record of registration of the business name, and to notify interest in a liquor licence business if the entity holding the registration certificate is not listed on your licence.
